name: Peach Fizz
source:
Main heroine is raised as a ninja in a shinobi village. Princess of the castle is captured while crossing state border. Protagonist rushes in pursuit only to be assaulted by enemy forces. What fate awaits princess and her loyal ninja?

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
女主角花散里自幼在忍者村中接受忍者訓練。箏姬在越過國境時遭人俘虜，花散里立即動身追趕，卻遭到敵軍襲擊。等待公主與忠心忍者的，究竟會是怎樣的命運？
